messages.subject: facet_grid manually define strip labels
parts:
Hi everyone

I really enjoy doing my graphs with ggplot (Thanks Hadley! Many
thanks!...).
After spending a lot of time googling for help I still have no clue
how to edit the strip labels of a facet_grid graph. Maybe this is not
possible in the current version of ggplot.
I would like to change the labels, let's say "N" (number of samples)
to "Number of samples", providing a ylab for each row of panels (or a
xlab for each column...) of the facet_grid graph.
Can anyone help me on this?
Thanks in advance

João Cúrdia

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: facet_grid manually define strip labels
parts:
Hi:

The simplest fix would be to define the levels of the grouping factor(s) such that the labels you want are automatically provided, or
alternatively, create a parallel grouping factor with the desired labels that you can substitute into the graph call.

HTH,
Dennis
